request: I run a small provisions shop in Madina and I want to keep my price list on the computer instead of in my notebook. I want to add the things I sell with their prices. I want to see everything I sell, and look up the price of one thing. Sometimes I stop selling something, so I want to take it off the list.
summary:
I've built your price list as `app.py`. All 14 checks I wrote for it pass. Your items are saved in a file called `shop.db` in the same folder, so the list is still there after you close and reopen the program.

**What you can do:**
- **POST /items**: add an item by giving its name and price (for example `{"name": "Milo 400g", "price": 12.50}`). The computer gives it an item number and sends the saved item back to you.
- **GET /items**: see every item on your list with its price.
- **GET /items/{itemNumber}**: look up one item and its price.
- **DELETE /items/{itemNumber}**: take an item off the list when you stop selling it.

**What it refuses:**
- An item with no name, or a name that is only spaces.
- An item with no price.
- A price that isn't a number. This includes a number typed inside quote marks, like `"5"`.
- A price below zero. A price of exactly 0 is allowed.

If you try any of these, nothing is saved and you get an error message. If you look up or remove an item number that isn't on the list, you're told it wasn't found and nothing changes.

Prices are treated as Ghana cedis with pesewas (for example 12.50). As the plan said, there's no way yet to change the price of an item already on the list, and nothing stops other people from seeing or changing the list. Tell me if you'd like either of those added.

plan.summary: This plan keeps your shop's price list on the computer instead of in your notebook. You will be able to add an item you sell with its price, see the whole list, look up the price of one item, and take an item off the list when you stop selling it. Nothing in your request was unsafe or outside the backend, so nothing was left out. A few questions for you, which are not in the plan unless you ask for them: (1) Prices sometimes go up or down. Would you like a way to change the price of an item that is already on the list? Right now you would have to take it off and add it again. (2) Should anyone be able to see or change the list, or only you? The plan has no protection of that kind because you did not ask for it. (3) Should prices be written in Ghana cedis with pesewas (for example 12.50)? The plan assumes they are.

data.name: Item
fields: Item number: a number the computer gives each item automatically so it can be found again
Name: what the item is called, for example 'Milo 400g' or 'Bag of rice 5kg'
Price: how much you sell it for, in Ghana cedis (for example 12.50)

endpoints.does: Adds a new item to your price list. You give the name and the price, and it is saved with its own item number.
Shows every item on your price list with its price.
Shows one item and its price, so you can quickly check how much something costs.
Takes an item off your price list when you stop selling it.

rules: An item cannot be added without a name.
An item cannot be added without a price.
The price must be a number and cannot be less than zero.
If you look up or try to remove an item that is not on the list, you are told it was not found and nothing is changed.
